passage:
The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality. Anyone could use the information to build apps or study problems.
A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade. They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.
Their report helped the city decide where to add shelters first.
Open data sounded boring at first. Then students saw that it could support fairness.
Information locked away helps only a few people. Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.

本文可直接核對「The Open Data Project: The city published open data about bus times, parks, public toilets, and air quality.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
